Mark your calendar! The Black Lives Matter at School action this school year will be held from February 4-8th, 2019. #BlackLivesMatter At School is a national committee educators organizing for racial justice in education. Sign up to join! https://t.co/nsW6JRh3AN

Today! 2/4 officially marks the launch of the national Black Lives Matter At School week of action. Educators will be posting their photos, lesson plans, and stories of the day on social media with the hashtag, #BlackLivesMatterAtSchool. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/bQtTju6uAL

Happy Birthday, #TrayvonMartin.  Sending love to your parents, family, and community. Your death was not in vain as we continue to fight for #BlackLives! #RIP #WeWillNeverForget #BlackHistoryMonth #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/a4ECUTH1l4

7 years ago today #TrayvonMartin was murdered. His death was not in vain as we continue the fight for racial justice and against the criminalization of #Black bodies. 

We will always remember you. You will not be forgotten. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/UWn4AuIKlJ

Liyah Birru, a #BlackImmigrant from Ethiopia, served a 6-yr sentence after fighting to stay safe from her abusive husband. At the end of her sentence, she was arrested by ICE and now she faces deportation!
#MeToo
